controls.evidence: Anzens mints/burns USDA 1:1 against segregated USD reserves and Treasuries custodied at BitGo Trust, gated by KYC bank transfers; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists on the Cardano native policy. On 2026-08-08, Koios policy_asset_list returned the single USDA asset under policy fe7c786ab321f41c654ef6c1af7b3250a613c24e4213e0425a7ae456 with raw supply 4,452,382,510,000 at six decimals. The policy remains PlutusV2, but its embedded signer/control parameters are not decoded by the public sources, so canRaiseCap remains unknown rather than inferred.

review.evidence: Anzens (FinCEN MSB) is the sole issuer of USDA on Cardano; mint/redeem is centralized 1:1 via KYC bank transfers against BitGo Trust-custodied reserves. Policy ID fe7c786ab321f41c654ef6c1af7b3250a613c24e4213e0425a7ae456 is a PlutusV2 script. Minting transactions include uid metadata but no required_signers field is exposed in Koios tx_info; the PlutusV2 script validates internally with signing key(s) embedded as script parameters that are not observable from chain state without full script-parameter decoding. Koios script_info confirms the policy was created in transaction 77f120599d05ed304970bb9bda15f2a8f56aa6495178065444c601f0212e675a with the USDA asset name embedded; Anzens/EMURGO publish custody-adjacent statements but no script parameterization or admin-control inventory, so the controlling signing keys remain unestablished from public sources. Rechecked 2026-08-08: Koios still returns type=plutusV2 and one policy asset, USDA, with raw supply 4,452,382,510,000 at six decimals; the Cardano Token Registry independently maps the same policy-plus-asset name to USDA. The public evidence still does not establish a hard supply ceiling or identify the embedded authorization threshold, so economicCapSemantics and canRaiseCap remain unknown. Reconciliation also remains unknown: the claimed series is four image-only Medium-hosted examination posts in 16 months, newest period 2026-01-31 (about six months stale while supply fell materially), with no machine-readable report naming the firm, period, or opinion and no current transparency surface on anzens.com. A stalled, unverifiable series cannot support recurring-reconciliation credit.
